svg.title: Why a young driver premium is high, and which levers are legal
svg.desc: Inexperience is the base. A conviction or at-fault claim stacks. The vehicle rate group stacks. Honest principal-operator status and documented kilometres are the legal levers. Not a quote.
svg.text: What actually stacks on a new driver
Order of the problem. Not a percent and not a province-wide table. 24 Sep 2026.
Plus a conviction or at-fault claim
Legal levers: truthful principal driver, a VIN priced before you buy, kilometres you can show, a second quote.
Listing a parent as principal on the teen's daily car is not one of the levers.
ICBC, MPI, and SGI use their own driver scales. This stack is the household question, not their formula.
Do not cut liability or Ontario medical benefits to pay for inexperience.
